shots.vo: What if the attacks of September eleventh, two thousand one, *never happened*?
The Twin Towers stand. *Two thousand nine hundred seventy-seven* people walk home from work that evening.
The airport. Shoes stay on, your water bottle comes with you, and your family walks you *right to the gate*.
America never goes to war in Afghanistan. *Twenty years of war* simply never happen.
No war in Iraq either. *Eight trillion dollars* stay in America.
No Patriot Act, no Department of Homeland Security. You fly, call and text *like it is the nineties*.
So what would the *world look like today*?
